## Butterfly Network, Inc. (BFLY) `[Medical Imaging Technology]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.
- A September 25 report cited Needham analyst David Saxon’s earlier Buy initiation and a $10 sum-of-the-parts target, plus a multi-year Butterfly Embedded licensing agreement with Merge Labs; the report did not provide a September 24 catalyst or contract value. (Simply Wall St)

## On Holding AG (ONON) `[Consumer Internet & Platforms]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.

## Vicor Corporation (VICR) `[Power & Wide-Bandgap]`
- No new company-specific catalyst found during the September 24–25 window.
- The prior September 21 announcement cited a new non-exclusive license for Vicor’s Vertical Power Delivery technology to a leading AI original-equipment manufacturer and raised third-quarter 2026 sequential revenue-growth guidance from nearly 10% to more than 20%; this older announcement was identified as the direct cause of the preceding move. (company announcement, as reported by ZAR Newsdesk)

## Innodata Inc. (INOD) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.
- The September 22 move was linked to a Hunterbrook report alleging that Innodata may have worked on Meta’s Muse AI assistant; the report estimated the account at approximately $146 million, or 58% of Innodata’s 2025 sales, but Meta and Innodata did not confirm the association. [rumor] (Economic Times)

## Dell Technologies Inc. (DELL) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Dell director Lynn Vojvodich Radakovich reported the sale of 2,022 shares at an average price of $565.28, totaling $1.14 million; Silver Lake-affiliated holders also reported sales, and MarketBeat cited approximately $5.7 million in director sales. (MarketBeat)
- A September 24 report said broader technology pressure and insider-selling activity were factors in the session; the report also cited a $999 “Googlebook” test, without identifying a company filing or official Dell announcement supporting that item. (Ad Hoc News)
- Dell’s fiscal second-quarter 2027 revenue was reported at $46.971 billion, and full-year fiscal 2027 revenue guidance was reported at $192.0 billion, with AI-optimized-server revenue guidance at $74.0 billion. (Ad Hoc News)
- Dell management reported $60.9 billion in AI orders during the fiscal second quarter of 2027. (Trefis)

## Marathon Petroleum Corporation (MPC) `[Energy & Refining]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.
- Investor’s Business Daily reported a revised 2027 EPS estimate of $45.81, 19% below its 2026 estimate and 32% above the prior-month 2027 estimate of $34.83. (Investor’s Business Daily)

## CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (CRWD) `[Cybersecurity Software]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.

## Salesforce, Inc. (CRM) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.

## Palantir Technologies Inc. (PLTR) `[AI Infrastructure]`
- Rosenblatt Securities reiterated a Buy rating and a $225 price target in a September 23 research note; the action was published before the specified September 24–25 window. (Rosenblatt Securities note, as reported by MarketBeat)
- A September 24 report cited a $48 million U.S. Army contract as a recent source of attention, but the report did not establish that the contract was announced during the specified window. (Rosenblatt Securities note, as reported by MarketBeat)
- The Federal Aviation Administration’s SMART system began limited Washington, D.C., operations on September 21, 2026, under a 12-year, $875 million award for which Air Space Intelligence—not Palantir—was identified as prime contractor. (FinanceFeeds)

## Phillips 66 (PSX) `[Energy & Refining]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.
- Investor’s Business Daily reported a revised 2027 EPS estimate of $25.45, down 9% from its 2026 estimate and 13% above the prior-month 2027 estimate of $22.47. (Investor’s Business Daily)

## ServiceNow, Inc. (NOW) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.

## Atlassian Corporation (TEAM) `[Software & SaaS]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in the September 24–25 window.
